authorInfo.bio: Walter Farquhar Hook (1798–1875) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.

description: "A Church Dictionary" by Walter Farquhar Hook is an ecclesiastical reference work written in the mid-19th century. The dictionary serves as an instructional text intended to clarify and explain important theological terms, church doctrines, and church practices for its readers, particularly laypersons and parishioners.
